_comment: The 2026-07-28 field feedback, as graded cases. One case per question a pharmacist actually asked at CityCare (Feedback_1..14 + Feedback_Summary), with expectations verified against the live :8091 database on 2026-08-02 — never guessed. Verified anchors: 1000000008626 AEROCORT INHALER (2 @ 20015-CCGV, 36500 MMK); 1000000347875 AMNOTAC 150 RANITIDINE 10`S mm_reg R2103AA3615; 1000000131948 BIOGESIC 500MG 10`S (380 @ 20015-CCGV, 1700 MMK); 1000000008745 MOTILIUM-M 10`S category 5102-PRESCRIPTION MEDICINE; 1000000008672 OMEZ 20MG 10`S (71 @ 20015-CCGV, 3000 MMK); 1000000360173 WICKS MENTHOL COUGH DROPS 20`S (28 @ 20015-CCGV); 1000000010002 AIR-X DROP 15ML. Every case carries expect_absent so a reasoning leak fails the run, not just a wrong fact — that is the regression these tickets are most likely to suffer.
